Updates the signed and notarized Mac menu bar app with the flat Möbius mark in accent blue. The full S-shaped cut remains visible at menu bar size.

Gateway behavior, protocol 82, checkpoint payload 17, and SQLite schema 10 are unchanged. If upgrading from a gateway before 0.15.43, follow the model-selection migration instructions in the [0.15.43 release notes](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/releases/tag/mobius-gateway-v0.15.43).
